headline: Propagation completed for all 369 generated IR, but GA4 did not obtain a complete, actionable DOE conclusion.
interpretation: The run now computes and publishes payload, sensitivity and requirement lineage through its generated graph. Every one of the 250 sensitive-data comparisons is explicitly unresolved, and no reduction is supplied. This is a material improvement in executable coverage over backend-r3, but not complete semantic or DOE success.
source_coverage_text: 13/13 inventoried API sites represented and computed via 7 primary API IR; 25/25 saves via 18 primary save IR; 3/3 loops have computed final writes. Shared/opaque identities retain limits.
findings: All 369 selected IR are processed; there are no cutoff, blocked or not-reached IR. The only propagation diagnostic is missing_part at ir_323. The source-site inventory is finite and does not include every semantic relationship.

All 38 remote send/receive positions preserve request identities, endpoints, actual request Data and candidate bindings. All 58 computed write positions (44 storage and 14 runtime-context writes) use replace. At all 18 primary save summaries, serialization consumes the incoming result identity; its output supplies the write, while the corresponding return uses the original result. Opaque serialization does not establish bytes or plaintext inclusion.

The loop summaries preserve occurrence/candidate information but 6 of 14 final reindex and status collection alternatives each retain multiple_generations ambiguity. A success branch at ir_323 still receives a caught-error wrapper, causing a spurious missing-value diagnostic; the valid parsed return survives. This is not evidence of a source runtime exception.

All 85 DOE positions match declared boundary objects. There are 81 sensitivity declarations in 58 scopes, with 78 reported resolved; all 250 comparisons are unresolved and all 85 sinks carry limitations. No positive DOE claim exists to confirm or refute.

Task has 39 requirements: 12 expressed, 20 partial and 7 retained-only. There are 163 positive goals with nonempty saved trace references. All sinks inherit 39 global blocking requirement diagnostics: 27 expression gaps, 7 unbound requirements and 5 Task source issues. A concrete runtime input not selected in a whole-Skill analysis is ordinary symbolic input; the audit does not endorse treating its absence as inherently unanalyzable.

Cache reads at ir_356 use caches while modeled updates use ga_cache/sc_cache/index_cache without a connecting relationship. This contradicts the source state identity. Filepath operands are not tied to exact write locations, and analysis-owned JSON to Markdown-summary continuation remains unmodeled. These are modeling limits despite computed boundary records.

Inspection response projection, local helper provenance and operation-specific demands remain incomplete. Full metadata/raw-save demands are distinguishable from field-limited return demands, but shared helper requirements still lack complete applicability. Three requires_prior checks reached a finite resource limit and are not established.

All 24 independent source relations are assessed: 6 supported, 1 contradicted (cache identity), 1 unresolved and 16 mixed. Mixed findings include source realtime calls collapsed into a shared request/response summary, missing .env creation, opaque indexing update/delete distinctions and unresolved file/demand applicability. Presence of each inventoried API site does not prove a distinct exact call and response for every source call. These labels are not an accuracy score.
fix_observations: No optional-case default crash occurred, and explicit empty bodies propagated legally. Initial processing/wire has 20 cases (3 explicit empty bodies); selected processing/wire has 33 cases (4 explicit empty bodies). Every case explicitly includes segments: omitted case-body defaults were NOT directly exercised by this online generation. Example: selected wire ir_171/segments/1/cases/0 has segments=[] and yields existing local base. The omitted-field branch remains supported by offline regression only.
Storage effects computed actual result-derived payloads; replace is the disclosed ordinary-write abstraction. Exact symbolic file identities and source-owned continuation remain unresolved.

The mapping prompt supplies actual normalized expression/self coordinates, including ir_154 verdict == PASS in the selected graph. No selected GA4 constraint uses condition or success, so this run does not exercise copying such a reference into those fields. Its mapping corrections concerned ordinary operation coordinates and incomplete realizations.

Initial review F007 is correctly owned by task-correspondence and routed only to that fragment. Processing and sensitivity repair prompts retain isolation. Final F006 instead targets processing while criticizing the R37 necessity demand owned by correspondence: a residual model ownership error, not automatic text-based rerouting. No second repair round was run.
blockers: Modeling and task-correspondence: cache/location identities, visible helper relationships, exact destinations, summary continuation and shared-operation demand applicability.

Demand/sensitivity and policy: incomplete Task realizations, global propagation of their blocking limitations, unresolved/absent declared sensitive ranges. These prevent all excess decisions despite extensive lineage.

Constraint backend: finite-resource limit on three requires_prior checks. Propagation backend: cross-arm retention and some multiple-generation loop ambiguity; neither stopped generated-IR propagation.

Interface/publication: the previous optional-default exception and ordinary output blockage did not prevent this run. Results and the sole replay were saved; review retains seven findings and the overall semantic result remains partial.
comparison: The previous backend-r3 GA4 stopped before propagation on the optional-case KeyError: 5 calls, 562,385 public tokens and 2,033.837 seconds. This run uses 16 calls, 2,795,255 public tokens and 9,799.905 seconds, but actually computes 369 IR and publishes DOE lineage. These costs cover different completed scopes, so no whole-flow speedup is claimed. Old v8 processed 29/420 IR and reached none of the 13 API/25 save sites. Old v9 remains paused, not completed. The offline r2 30-minute attempt used another fixed annotation (326/347 IR before DOE timeout); its timings are not a same-input speed comparison.

finite_correctness_assessment.scope: Navigation labels only, not an accuracy score.
